title: The Spoiled Milk
scene: At 5:10 AM, the dairy milk crate was emptied. The cooling room was latched from 4:50 to 5:30.

suspects.name: Ada Reed
suspects.testimony: I was milking in the barn at 5:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The barn camera shows Ada at 5:08 and 5:14.

suspects.name: Colin Hale
suspects.testimony: I was loading the truck at 5:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The loading log shows Colin's scan at 5:09.

suspects.name: Greta Voss
suspects.testimony: I was in the cooling room at 5:10, checking the temperature.
suspects.contradiction: The cooling room was latched from outside, and milk residue marked Greta's sleeve.

suspects.name: Ivor Lund
suspects.testimony: I was fixing the tractor at 5:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The tool board shows Ivor's wrench out at 5:05 and back at 5:20.
